seo_title: SSO AI Agent: Secure Authentication for Corporate Bots
seo_desc: Protect your corporate Telegram bots. We integrate AI with Google Login, securing the root directory and validating Stripe payments in production.
author_pitch: As an AI specialist, I have seen too many companies expose their billing and data by integrating unsecured bots. My goal is to shield your automations with solid architectures, from origin validation to production deployment, so you can scale without risks.
title: SSO Authentication AI Agent: Shield Your Bots and Prevent Data Leaks
body:
Are your corporate bots an open backdoor to your data?

Every day, dozens of SMEs launch chatbots on messaging apps to streamline operations. The problem explodes when these assistants, connected to OpenAI keys and internal databases, lack robust security protocols. Unauthorized employees or former workers continue to access sensitive information, and unprotected endpoints lead to massive data leaks that sink the business's reputation and profitability.

The trap of Bots without Native Authentication

Most agencies install third-party scripts or migrate patched code that leaves critical vulnerabilities on the server, ignoring access policies. A smart bot without a strict validation layer is an unacceptable risk for your company.

Our solution: AI Architecture with Zero-Trust Authentication

At LANZAESTUDIO we tackle the problem from the server's root. We develop AI agents that operate natively and securely, integrating unbreakable corporate authentication protocols before processing a single request or authorizing a payment.

  1. Native execution from the root directory: We host the Telegram bot directly in the domain's root, guaranteeing that the main file operates with maximum efficiency and firewall control without relying on redirects or flawed migrations.
  2. Authentication via Google Login: We implement a strict OAuth flow, precisely configuring authorized JavaScript origins and redirect URIs so that only your team can access.
  3. Secure connection with the OpenAI API: We isolate credentials and calls to the language model, preventing external requests from draining your credits or injecting malicious prompts.
  4. Flawless transition of Stripe to Production: We integrate the bot with your payment gateway, ensuring a safe move from test mode to the real environment (production) to manage B2B collections seamlessly.

The Real Impact on B2B Security and Billing

  • Zero corporate data leaks: By requiring identity verification, we block 100% of unauthorized access to your systems.
  • Cash flow protection: Payment integrations operate in a certified environment, eliminating transactional errors in the live gateway.
  • Guaranteed technical scalability: A solid infrastructure well-placed on your server allows adding new AI features without destabilizing the web ecosystem.
